text: You need the holy relics to defeat the Demon King.
You skedaddled and started your journey.
You arrive at an ancient temple. In front of you are 3 passages.
After searching around for a while, you find a note on the ground.
note:
The first shall grant thee safety,
The second fortune untold,
But only a fool ...

text: The rest of the note seems to be missing.

text: You decide to search for another hour for possible clues. You find another torn note beneath some rubble.
note:
The first shall grant thee safety,
The second fortune untold,
But only a fool would trust their words,
For the third holds secrets never told.

text: You go into the 3rd passage and find the Breastplate of Earth.
You decide to enter one of the two passages. However, you soon realize it was a trap.
Fortunately, you managed to escape. A little knowledge [[can be dangerous|a little knowledge is a dangerous thing]], after all! The passage to the first relic is now sealed forever.

heading: MAGIC BARRIER
text: You have reached the summit of a snowy mountain. However, you soon realize that your passage to the 2nd relic is blocked by a magical gate.
note:
Beyond the gate lies relics of old,
Take the winding path, if haste you hold,
But those who wait shall find the gate opened when the moon grows bold.

heading: MAGIC BARRIER
text: You search around for possible clues. Alongside the sign, you find another path leading to the 2nd relic. While it looks somewhat dangerous, the weather is favorable enough to cross it. Who knows how long that will last?
note:
Beyond the gate lie relics of old,
Take the winding path, if haste you hold,
Yet those who wait, when the moon shines bright,
Shall find their way by silver light.

text: You decide to go up the path. While things go smoothly at first, you injure yourself badly by slipping on the ice. Nevertheless, you get the relic.

heading: MAGIC BARRIER
text: You decide to wait until the moon rises. The magical gate disappears and you get the 2nd relic.
The Demon King awaits. To be continued...
